policy: Both policies use blind independent directions. Visible-intent adapts to the same current intent/status and team shown in the UI; no future-room, encounter or reward inspection. No scouting used. Camps rest; no free lesson chosen.
notes: Bot rates are not human win rates or engagement metrics.
Three hunts rotate by seed; completion is pooled across them.
Fresh and upgraded start with one normal individual. Collected-shiny starts with one endowed perfect shiny plus capped upgrades.
Collection-6 uses six endowed normal IV-18 individuals without upgrades.
The six-room mode has one guardian battle; boss clear and full clear are equivalent. Exact reach and conditional rates are included.
The original 51,000-campaign baseline/control suite remains separately mandatory.
